checks: All blocks complete without hidden retries or shadow routing changes.
Independent verifier validates frozen sources, model identities, profile stability, embeddings, citations and stored primary outputs.
Compare primary prompt/output multisets across all four blocks.
Inspect all unique stage outputs and each final against the same exact arithmetic reference.

limits: One authored synthetic task repeated twelve times; no independent quality acceptance.

metrics: Descriptive phase, indexing, primary/embedding/shadow HTTP timings and model-presence snapshots. No continuous RSS/GPU-memory peak is claimed.
